newsitem.title: USA: Atlantic Beverage buys Partin's Sausage.
newsitem.headline: Atlantic Beverage buys Partin's Sausage.

text.p: Atlantic Beverage Co said Tuesday that it will pay an undisclosed price to buy Partin's Sausage of Cunningham, Ky.
Partin's Sausage has pork sausage manufacturing and distribution facilities in five states and sells its products under the Partin's and Brundage brand names.
The purchase is Atlantic Beverage's fifth since January, and reflects the meat processing company's new corporate strategy, according to Alan Sussna, Atlantic's president and chief executive officer.
The Northbrook-based company also distributes specialty non-alcoholic beverages.
